# Marimo Studio 0.1.3

Marimo Studio 0.1.3 links rendered results to notebook values with Marimo Lens,
coordinates multi-file source edits, and refines the documentation and examples.

## Select results with Marimo Lens

- Lens 0.0.10 or newer can select native cells, rich outputs, individual values,
  and custom JavaScript-rendered regions with their producing notebook context.
- Studio supplies cell and variable labels. Custom renderers link their actual
  inputs through existing projection hosts and `data-marimo-sources`. Labels
  follow projection changes and respect authored overrides.
- The nine example views expose individual metrics, rows, charts, and report
  pages, with capture support for their fonts and WebGL surfaces. Views with
  dynamic selectors use WebAssembly exports. Prepared exports retain finite
  authored targets.
- Lens remains an optional installation. Provider instructions and the Studio
  skill explain source links, rendering readiness, and feedback workflows.

## Coordinate source edits

- View inspection reports current source inventories, the retained successful
  artifact, and the latest build attempt separately.
- Python `hold_publication()` / `release_publication()` and CLI `view hold` /
  `view release` let editors change several files while retaining the current
  preview. Holds expire or release into source reconciliation.
- Agents can compare source inventories, recover retained document content,
  and inspect malformed manifests through the existing repair path.
- The packaged skill exposes version-matched guidance through Python help and
  directs agents to open the first starter view before substantial authoring work.

## Documentation and examples

The documentation uses simpler navigation and styling. Example views refine
responsive layouts, charts, and notebook controls across screen sizes.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.1.3 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and Marimo 0.24.0. React,
Reveal.js, and Svelte authoring use the optional Deno 2.9.5 dependency.

[All changes since 0.1.2](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3)
